dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is there anything you'd like to do?

dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: Yeah, let's work together and make a big, shiny, golden statue and place it out where everyone can see!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So is this your recommendation as my new "renovation consultant"?

dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: That's right. I've been thinking about what this place is lacking...

dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: And then it hit me. What's missing is more shiny gold! Hehe!

choices.text: In that case... why don't we make a golden Dori statue?

response.speaker: Dori
response.text: But maybe we should wait until you can afford the rights to use my image.

response.speaker: Dori
response.text: For now, we can start with a simple Mora sculpture!

response.speaker: Dori
response.text: Because this place could potentially serve as my base, naturally, it should be to my liking!

response.speaker: Dori
response.text: #But let's get one thing straight: This is a collaboration between {NICKNAME} and the eminent Lord Sangemah Bay.

response.speaker: Dori
response.text: So you better bring your best to the project.

response.speaker: Dori
response.text: I prepared all the tools and raw gold a few days ago. Anyway, I'll cover the expenses this time, as long as you perform the labor!

response.speaker: Dori
response.text: Come talk to me when you're ready to get to work.

choices.text: How about... we make a shiny, golden Mora sculpture?

response.speaker: Dori
response.text: Haha, at long last, my tastes are beginning to rub off on you, my young apprentice!

response.speaker: Dori
response.text: Alright, we'll make a Mora sculpture!
